elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Clause 10(c)(ii) limits “each Party's total aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although the cap uses the greater of 12 months’ paid or payable fees and $1,000,000, the lookback precedes the “event giving rise to the claim,” not the claim itself.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Clause 10(c)(i) states that “neither Party” is liable to the other for indirect or consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party’s breach of confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the aggregate cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breaches of data protection or security obligations are expressly included in Excluded Claims.
A Party’s indemnification obligations are expressly included in Excluded Claims.
Gross negligence is expressly included in Excluded Claims.
Wilful misconduct is expressly included in Excluded Claims.
Fraud is expressly included in Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement of the other Party’s intellectual property rights is expressly included in Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The Company’s obligation to pay amounts due under Section 3 is expressly not treated as damages subject to or counted against the limitation.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: The cap is the greater of a 12-month fee measure and $1,000,000, rather than a straight 12-month-fee cap; its lookback also precedes the event giving rise to the claim.
A Party’s indemnification obligations are expressly included in Excluded Claims.
